import os, sys, copy, torch, torch.distributed as dist, torch.multiprocessing as mp
import torch.nn.functional as F
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from transformers import LlamaConfig, LlamaForCausalLM
from pipeline_parallel import train_step_pipeline_afab

def run(rank, ws, port):
    os.environ.update(MASTER_ADDR="127.0.0.1", MASTER_PORT=str(port))
    dist.init_process_group("gloo", rank=rank, world_size=ws)
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    cfg = LlamaConfig(vocab_size=100, hidden_size=32, intermediate_size=64, num_hidden_layers=5,
                      num_attention_heads=4, num_key_value_heads=2)
    model = LlamaForCausalLM(cfg); ref = copy.deepcopy(model)
    inputs = [torch.randint(0,100,(2,8)) for _ in range(3)]
    targets = [torch.randint(0,100,(2,8)) for _ in range(3)]
    loss = train_step_pipeline_afab(model, inputs, targets, torch.device("cpu"), torch.float32)
    rl = 0
    for x,t in zip(inputs, targets):
        l = F.cross_entropy(ref(x).logits.reshape(-1,100), t.reshape(-1))/3; l.backward(); rl += l.item()
    ok = True; n = 0
    for (name,p),(_,q) in zip(model.named_parameters(), ref.named_parameters()):
        if p.grad is not None:
            n += 1
            if not torch.allclose(p.grad, q.grad, atol=1e-5): ok=False; print("mismatch", name)
    print(f"ws={ws} rank={rank} params_with_grad={n} ok={ok} loss={loss} ref={rl:.5f}")
    dist.destroy_process_group()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    for ws, port in [(1, 29511), (2, 29512)]:
        mp.spawn(run, args=(ws, port), nprocs=ws)
EOF
